speaker: alice_brambleby
text: Sixpence the supper, Master Shakespeare, and the bread is the bread the City has. Sit where you can hear, if you mean to hear. I am not charging you a second time for the same pot.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Sixpence. I have eaten a short loaf already today. I can hear from here.

speaker: (the gunner)
text: Every kitchen pot in Guiana is beaten gold. I have the chart. A greased chart does not lie. The Spanish Main is measured on it, and the pots are at the end of the measure.

speaker: george_bryan
text: A chart greases as easily as a story. I have seen both.

speaker: (the gunner)
text: Forty ships went. The Queen blessed them. A man who was not on the quay should keep his doubt off a chart that was.

speaker: will_kemp
text: I ask you with great respect, sir. Why are you in Bishopsgate? The gold, if it is gold, is a long way from this board, and Bishopsgate is where I can see your elbows.

speaker: (the gunner)
text: A man comes home to tell it. If he stays on the water, the City never knows the pots are gold. That is why a chart is carried. To be believed at a distance.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Anyone who truly knew the road to riches would go quietly.

speaker: (the gunner)
text: Quiet never filled a purse. Noise is how a voyage gets its beef. Forty ships do not slip out like a wherry.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I had forty this morning from a waterman, with salt beef under it. I have not counted the ships. The beef I will grant him.

speaker: will_kemp
text: And the respect I offered is still on the table, sir. A chart in Bishopsgate is a chart among men who have to pay sixpence for their supper. That is a different arithmetic from a pot of gold.

speaker: alice_brambleby
text: Talk is welcome. I have not closed a mouth yet. Sixpence buys the stool. It does not buy a creed.

speaker: (the gunner)
text: The further the country, the surer the gold. Every sailor knows it. A near coast is herrings. A far coast is plate.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Then the surest gold is the gold no one in this room has seen. I find that a comfortable doctrine for the man who owns the chart.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Bread is dear in my house. The loaf is a finger short of the notch. I can hold that in my hand. I cannot hold Guiana.

speaker: will_kemp
text: There. He has said a thing you can bite. Your pots, sir, I cannot bite. I have tried farthings in my time. Gold that lives in a kitchen I have not met.

speaker: (the gunner)
text: You will meet it when the ships come home. Doubt is a small habit. The voyage is larger than a supper.

speaker: alice_brambleby
text: Let him talk. He has not yet called a man's doubt a treason. When he does, the door knows its work. Until then, the chart may stay on the board.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am listening to the distance. The sureness grows as the ship gets further from the room. I have not heard a weight, or a date, or a name of a pot.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Nor will you. A quiet man would already be gone. This one is here. That is the whole of my objection.

speaker: (the gunner)
text: Then look at the chart. The grease is honest. The line of the Main is honest. Your short loaf is a City complaint, and Guiana is the cure of it.

speaker: will_kemp
text: With the same respect as before, sir. A cure that cannot be served at sixpence is a cure I shall applaud when it arrives, and not before.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Then let us eat the sixpence. A chart can remain a chart until its owner makes a treason of it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am eating. I have the beef from this morning, and I still have not counted a ship.

speaker: alice_brambleby
text: Enough of cures. Eat. The next man who makes a loyalty out of a kitchen pot can take the pot into the lane.
